limitations: Not tested on Linux, macOS, AMD or other GPUs; CI definitions do not imply those runs passed.
Clean checkout used the same installed Python environment, not a fresh dependency installation.
Earlier features were checked through Gradio API/configuration and unit tests. Version 0.5.0 additionally has end-to-end Edge browser checks for curves, comparison, saving and result reuse.
IIB menu patch is optional and revision-dependent. Image Edit does not automatically modify another extension.
Full numerical parity with upstream ComfyUI/diffusers is not established.
Only supported named architectures and compatible components are validated; arbitrary edit checkpoints are not supported.
No universal image-editing quality guarantee; Turbo extra steps are experimental.
CFG 1 models ignore negative prompts; Dev uses text-only unconditional conditioning.
Model weights and their licenses are separate; no weights, example images or private settings are in this release.

Lower-VRAM validation uses simulated 12/16 GiB budgets on a 24 GiB GPU, not physical 12/16 GiB cards. Quantization validation covers the exact listed files, not every GGUF, FP4, AWQ/GPTQ or language-only encoder.

Whole-image edits can regenerate fine texture. The removed auto-correction UI is not restored by older recipes. The community Qwen texture-fix VAE targets its decoder grid, not exact reconstruction. No Fibo-specific decoder fix is included.
